_purpose: Single source of truth for the GL-conditional dropdown option sets that backend/app/special_gl.py validates AND the frontend (frontend/src/subform/glDropdownConstants.ts) must render identically. A backend test (test_special_gl_fixture_parity.py) and a frontend test (glDropdownConstants.test.ts) each load this SAME file and assert their own hardcoded constants match it — so the two languages can never silently drift apart. Sourced from docs/13Template Special/_dropdown_summary.md (that folder is gitignored — large Excel source dumps — so this derived JSON lives here in docs/reference/ instead, where it is tracked and reachable in CI). Training & Seminar's Method dropdown is deliberately NOT here: special_gl.py does not validate it server-side (free-form meta_json), so there is nothing to keep in parity — it stays a frontend-only UI convenience list.
